title: File:ObeliscoBA2015.jpg
claims: The photograph shows the Obelisco de Buenos Aires as a tall white obelisk in a landscaped plaza, with the Avenida 9 de Julio traffic, buildings, a flag and pedestrians around it; it is a city landmark view, not a race arch, timing mat, aid station, closed course or race-day crowd.

The file page identifies the subject as the Obelisco de Buenos Aires and places the camera at 34.604866 S, 58.381538 W; the route page uses the photograph only as the landmark that the 2026 route passes near, not as proof of the race route or race-day conditions.

The author is Sebastianalmaraz; the file is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0; the photograph was taken on 2015-10-13 at 18:21:05; the original is 3,264 x 2,448 pixels and 2,447,250 bytes; the camera location is 34.604866 S, 58.381538 W.
The route page uses a 960 x 720 copy of 201,085 bytes without cropping or colour change and credits Sebastianalmaraz, CC BY-SA 4.0, Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
